title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 28
description: Ten questions on Numbers 28: the daily offerings, the Sabbath, the new months, the Passover and the feast of weeks.

questions.text: How many male lambs a year old were to be offered day by day as the continual burnt offering?
questions.explanation: Yahweh commanded male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

questions.text: When were the two lambs of the continual burnt offering to be offered?
questions.explanation: The one lamb was to be offered in the morning and the other lamb at evening.

answers.text: One in the morning and one at evening
One at noon and the other at midnight

questions.text: Where was the continual burnt offering ordained, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: It is called a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

questions.text: What burnt offering was to be offered on the Sabbath day?
questions.explanation: On the Sabbath day they were to offer two male lambs a year old without defect, with a meal offering and its drink offering.

answers.text: One young bull and one ram
Seven male lambs a year old
Two young bulls and two rams
Two male lambs a year old without defect

questions.text: At the beginnings of the months, what was the drink offering for each bull?
questions.explanation: Their drink offerings were half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb.

answers.text: The third part of a hin
The fourth part of a hin

questions.text: Besides the burnt offering, what was offered for a sin offering at the beginnings of the months?
questions.explanation: One male goat was to be offered for a sin offering to Yahweh, in addition to the continual burnt offering.

questions.text: On which day was Yahweh's Passover?
questions.explanation: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh's Passover.

answers.text: The fifteenth day of the first month
The fourteenth day of the first month
The tenth day of the seventh month
The first day of the seventh month

questions.text: For how long was unleavened bread to be eaten in the feast that started on the fifteenth day?
questions.explanation: On the fifteenth day of the month there was a feast, and unleavened bread was to be eaten for seven days.

questions.text: In that feast, how much fine flour was offered as a meal offering for each bull?
questions.explanation: The meal offering was fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for a bull and two tenths for the ram.

questions.text: The day of the first fruits, when a new meal offering was brought, belonged to which feast?
questions.explanation: In the day of the first fruits they offered a new meal offering to Yahweh in their feast of weeks, with a holy convocation.

answers.text: The day of blowing of trumpets
